\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 302-305 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R310-first-pass-words-from-chapters-302-305}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to give up and to repeat.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to sew, to iron, to cut, to chop, to grind
  \item to weigh, to count, to add, to save, to bargain
  \item to breathe, to sneeze, to shiver, to swell, to itch
  \item to deposit, to withdraw, to join, to meet, to visit
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To sew? (\textbf{\ml{തുന്നുക}}, \emph{tunnuka}.) To iron? (\textbf{\ml{ഇസ്തിരിയിടുക}}, \emph{istiriyiṭuka}.) To cut? (\textbf{\ml{മുറിക്കുക}}, \emph{muṟikkuka}.) To chop? (\textbf{\ml{അരിയുക}}, \emph{ariyuka}.) To grind? (\textbf{\ml{അരയ്ക്കുക}}, \emph{araykkuka}.) To weigh? (\textbf{\ml{തൂക്കുക}}, \emph{tūkkuka}.) To count? (\textbf{\ml{എണ്ണുക}}, \emph{eṇṇuka}.) To add? (\textbf{\ml{കൂട്ടുക}}, \emph{kūṭṭuka}.) To save? (\textbf{\ml{ലാഭിക്കുക}}, \emph{lābhikkuka}.) To bargain? (\textbf{\ml{വിലപേശുക}}, \emph{vilapēśuka}.) To breathe? (\textbf{\ml{ശ്വസിക്കുക}}, \emph{śvasikkuka}.) To sneeze? (\textbf{\ml{തുമ്മുക}}, \emph{tummuka}.) To shiver? (\textbf{\ml{വിറയ്ക്കുക}}, \emph{viṟaykkuka}.) To swell? (\textbf{\ml{വീർക്കുക}}, \emph{vīrkkuka}.) To itch? (\textbf{\ml{ചൊറിയുക}}, \emph{coṟiyuka}.) To deposit? (\textbf{\ml{നിക്ഷേപിക്കുക}}, \emph{nikṣēpikkuka}.) To withdraw? (\textbf{\ml{പിൻവലിക്കുക}}, \emph{pinvalikkuka}.) To join? (\textbf{\ml{ചേരുക}}, \emph{cēruka}.) To meet? (\textbf{\ml{കണ്ടുമുട്ടുക}}, \emph{kaṇṭumuṭṭuka}.) To visit? (\textbf{\ml{സന്ദർശിക്കുക}}, \emph{sandarśikkuka}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 306-310 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R310-second-pass-words-from-chapters-306-310}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to correct and to translate.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to correct, to translate, to cancel, to postpone, to feel
  \item to raise, to grow, to act, to burst, to praise
  \item to hit, to kick, to collect, to take a photo, to type
  \item to reduce, to recognize, to lock, to describe, to avoid
  \item to slip, to scrub, to untie, to give up, to repeat
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To correct? (\textbf{\ml{തിരുത്തുക}}, \emph{tiruttuka}.) To translate? (\textbf{\ml{വിവർത്തനം} \ml{ചെയ്യുക}}, \emph{vivarttanaṁ ceyyuka}.) To cancel? (\textbf{\ml{റദ്ദാക്കുക}}, \emph{ṟaddākkuka}.) To postpone? (\textbf{\ml{മാറ്റിവയ്ക്കുക}}, \emph{māṟṟivaykkuka}.) To feel? (\textbf{\ml{തോന്നുക}}, \emph{tōnnuka}.) To raise? (\textbf{\ml{വളർത്തുക}}, \emph{vaḷarttuka}.) To grow? (\textbf{\ml{വളരുക}}, \emph{vaḷaruka}.) To act? (\textbf{\ml{അഭിനയിക്കുക}}, \emph{abhinayikkuka}.) To burst? (\textbf{\ml{പൊട്ടിക്കുക}}, \emph{poṭṭikkuka}.) To praise? (\textbf{\ml{പുകഴ്ത്തുക}}, \emph{pukaḻttuka}.) To hit? (\textbf{\ml{അടിക്കുക}}, \emph{aṭikkuka}.) To kick? (\textbf{\ml{ചവിട്ടുക}}, \emph{caviṭṭuka}.) To collect? (\textbf{\ml{ശേഖരിക്കുക}}, \emph{śēkharikkuka}.) To take a photo? (\textbf{\ml{ഫോട്ടോ} \ml{എടുക്കുക}}, \emph{phōṭṭō eṭukkuka}.) To type? (\textbf{\ml{ടൈപ്പ്} \ml{ചെയ്യുക}}, \emph{ṭaippŭ ceyyuka}.) To reduce? (\textbf{\ml{കുറയ്ക്കുക}}, \emph{kuṟaykkuka}.) To recognize? (\textbf{\ml{തിരിച്ചറിയുക}}, \emph{tiriccaṟiyuka}.) To lock? (\textbf{\ml{പൂട്ടുക}}, \emph{pūṭṭuka}.) To describe? (\textbf{\ml{വിവരിക്കുക}}, \emph{vivarikkuka}.) To avoid? (\textbf{\ml{ഒഴിവാക്കുക}}, \emph{oḻivākkuka}.) To slip? (\textbf{\ml{തെന്നുക}}, \emph{tennuka}.) To scrub? (\textbf{\ml{ഉരയ്ക്കുക}}, \emph{uraykkuka}.) To untie? (\textbf{\ml{അഴിക്കുക}}, \emph{aḻikkuka}.) To give up? (\textbf{\ml{ഉപേക്ഷിക്കുക}}, \emph{upēkṣikkuka}.) To repeat? (\textbf{\ml{ആവർത്തിക്കുക}}, \emph{āvarttikkuka}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
